title: LaunchReel Storyboard
description: The ONLY artifact the LLM storyboard-writer produces. The renderer is deterministic Remotion: it never runs LLM-authored code. Exactly six scenes in fixed order (hook, problem, tour_a, tour_b, social_proof, cta). Output is always 1080x1920 @ 30fps; total length = sum of scene durationSec (target ~30s). Asset paths are RELATIVE TO the job's assets dir (the --assets flag); render.ts copies them into the Remotion public dir and rewrites them. Optional assets may be omitted or "" — scenes degrade to solid brand-color fields.

oneLiner.description: Positioning line, used as Hook/CTA fallback copy.

url.description: Display URL for the browser frame + CTA pill, e.g. "launchreel.pages.dev".

logoPath.description: Optional logo image (assets-relative). Currently informational; wordmark is drawn from name.

colors.description: Hex colors (#RGB or #RRGGBB). bg=page background (keep LIGHT — borders/text use ink). accent=primary brand color. ink=near-black for borders/text. Optional paper/accent2..4 flesh out the pop palette; missing accents are derived from accent by hue rotation.

scenes.description: Six scenes in fixed order. Recommended durations: hook 5, problem 5, tour_a 6, tour_b 6, social_proof 5, cta 3 (=30s).

headline.description: Big on-screen line. Kept SHORT (3-7 words); last word gets an accent chip in hook/problem.

sub.description: Supporting line / callout / CTA button label depending on scene.

screenshotPaths.description: REAL product screenshots (assets-relative). tour_a uses [0]; tour_b uses [0]; problem [0] is shown desaturated. Take with agent-browser at 1440x900.

value.description: Numeric part animates a count-up; prefix/suffix preserved (e.g. "$4.2M", "92%", "10,000+"). Non-numeric ("OpenAI") renders static.

metrics.description: tour_a shows up to 3 as a tile row; tour_b uses metrics[0] as the hero zoom-on-payoff; social_proof shows up to 3.

bgVideoPath.description: Optional muted Veo b-roll rendered UNDER the text (hook/cta only). Never put UI/text through gen-video.

voPath.description: Optional voiceover track (assets-relative). Ducks music to 22%.

watermark.description: true = free tier: persistent "made with LaunchReel" corner tag + CTA ribbon.
